facts.claim: Through its three companies—Honor Foods, Trinity Logistics, and Eagle Business Credit—Burris provides foodservice redistribution, freight management, and innovative technology, operating under the ONEBURRIS brand.
facts.source_snippet: Through our three companies, Honor Foods, Trinity Logistics, and Eagle Business Credit we provide foodservice redistribution, freight management, and innovative technology to keep businesses moving.
